blocks.text: Remainder theorem ke baad ab us ka sab se mashhoor natija: factor theorem. Numbers mein aap jaante hain ke 3, number 12 ka factor hai kyun ke \(12 \div 3\) karne par remainder 0 bachta hai. Bilkul isi tarah \(x - a\) polynomial \(f(x)\) ka factor tab hai jab is se divide karne par remainder 0 ho. Aur remainder theorem keh chuka hai ke yeh remainder \(f(a)\) hai. Bas! Factor theorem yahin se nikalta hai: remainder zero, yani \(f(a) = 0\).

Kitab ki statement: polynomial \(x - a\), polynomial \(f(x)\) ka factor hai iff \(f(a) = 0\). Doosre lafzon mein \(x - a\), \(f(x)\) ka factor tab aur sirf tab hai jab \(x = a\) polynomial equation \(f(x) = 0\) ka root (hal) ho.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
"iff" ka matlab hai "if and only if" (agar aur sirf agar). Is ek jumle mein do baatein chhupi hain:
1. Agar \(f(a) = 0\) ho, to \(x - a\) factor hai.
2. Agar \(x - a\) factor ho, to \(f(a) = 0\) hoga.
Yeh dono raaste humein kaam dete hain: factor check karna ho to sirf value nikalein; aur agar factors diye hon aur coefficients unknown hon, to har factor ke liye \(f(a) = 0\) likh kar equations bana lein.
Ek naya lafz bhi: jis value \(a\) par \(f(a) = 0\) ho, use \(f\) ka root ya zero kehte hain. Yani "factor" aur "root" ek hi sikke ke do rukh hain.

Proof do hisson mein hai, kyun ke "iff" ki dono baatein saabit karni hain. Pehla hissa: maan lein \(q(x)\) quotient aur \(R\) remainder hai jab \(f(x)\) ko \(x - a\) se itna divide karein ke remainder mein \(x\) na bache. To remainder theorem se
\[f(x) = (x - a)\,q(x) + R\]

Ab maan lein \(f(a) = 0\). Remainder theorem kehta hai \(R = f(a)\), is liye \(R = 0\). To
\[f(x) = (x - a)\,q(x)\]
Yani \((x - a)\), \(f(x)\) ka factor hai.

Doosra hissa (conversely, yani ulti taraf se): agar \((x - a)\), \(f(x)\) ka factor ho, to kisi polynomial \(q(x)\) ke liye \(f(x) = (x - a)q(x)\). Is mein \(x = a\) rakhein:
\[f(a) = (a - a)q(a) = 0\]
Is tarah theorem saabit ho gaya.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Dono hisson mein wohi jaadu hai jo remainder theorem mein tha: \(x = a\) par \((a - a) = 0\) ho jata hai, aur zero ko kisi bhi cheez se zarb dein to zero. Pehle hisse mein \(R = 0\) is liye hai ke \(R = f(a)\) aur \(f(a) = 0\) diya hua hai.
Khud sochiye: agar \(f(3) = 5\) ho to kya \(x - 3\) factor hai? (Jawab: nahin. Remainder 5 hai, zero nahin.)

blocks.title: Example 5
blocks.problem: Show that \(x - 2\) is a factor of \(f(x) = x^{3} - 7x + 6\) without factorizing.
steps:
Given: \(f(x) = x^{3} - 7x + 6\) aur linear polynomial \(x - 2\).
To prove: \(x - 2\), \(f(x)\) ka factor hai, factorize kiye baghair.
Method: sawal factorize karne se mana kar raha hai, is liye factor theorem lagayenge: sirf \(f(2)\) nikal kar dekhna hai ke zero hai ya nahin.

Step 1: \(a\) maloom karein
\[x - a = x - 2 \Rightarrow a = 2\]
Kyun: divisor ko \(x - a\) se milaya; \(x - 2 = 0\) se bhi \(x = 2\) milta hai.

Step 2: \(f(2)\) nikalein
\[f(2) = 2^{3} - 7(2) + 6\]
\[= 8 - 14 + 6 = 0\]
Kyun: factor theorem ke liye sirf \(a = 2\) par value chahiye. Dhyan dein ke \(f(x)\) mein \(x^{2}\) wali term nahin hai; us ka coefficient 0 hai, is liye kuch jama nahin hua.

Step 3: Natija
\(f(2) = 0\) hai, is liye \(x - 2\), \(f(x)\) ka factor hai.
Kyun: \(f(a) = 0\) hi factor theorem ki shart hai. Exam mein yeh aakhri jumla zaroor likhein; sirf "= 0" likh kar chhor dena adhoora jawab hai.

blocks.title: Note
blocks.text: Kitab ka note: yeh maloom karne ke liye ke diya hua linear polynomial \(x - a\), \(f(x)\) ka factor hai ya nahin, humein sirf yeh check karna hai ke \(f(a) = 0\) hai ya nahin.

Ab ulta kaam: factors diye hue hain aur polynomial ke coefficients \(p\), \(q\) maloom karne hain. Do unknowns hain, to humein do equations chahiye, aur do factors humein bilkul do equations de denge.

blocks.title: Example 6
blocks.problem: If \(x + 1\) and \(x - 2\) are factors of \(x^{3} + px^{2} + qx + 2\). Find the values of \(p\) and \(q\).
steps:
Given: \(f(x) = x^{3} + px^{2} + qx + 2\), jis ke factors \(x + 1\) aur \(x - 2\) hain.
To find: \(p\) aur \(q\).
Method: factor theorem se \(f(-1) = 0\) aur \(f(2) = 0\). Yeh \(p\) aur \(q\) mein do equations hongi; inhein simultaneous equations ki tarah hal karenge.

Step 1: Factor \(x + 1\) istemal karein
\[f(-1) = 0\]
\[-1 + p - q + 2 = 0\]
\[p - q = -1 \quad \text{...(i)}\]
Kyun: \(x + 1 = x - (-1)\), to \(a = -1\). Har term alag dekhein: \((-1)^{3} = -1\), \(p(-1)^{2} = p\), \(q(-1) = -q\), aur constant 2. Phir \(-1 + 2 = 1\) ko doosri taraf le gaye.

Step 2: Factor \(x - 2\) istemal karein
\[f(2) = 0\]
\[8 + 4p + 2q + 2 = 0\]
\[4p + 2q = -10\]
\[2p + q = -5 \quad \text{...(ii)}\]
Kyun: \(a = 2\); \(2^{3} = 8\), \(p(2)^{2} = 4p\), \(q(2) = 2q\). Poori equation ko 2 se divide kiya taa ke numbers chhote ho jayein.

Step 3: (i) aur (ii) ko jama karein
\[(p - q) + (2p + q) = -1 + (-5)\]
\[3p = -6\]
\[p = -2\]
Kyun: (i) mein \(-q\) aur (ii) mein \(+q\) hai; jama karne se \(q\) khatam ho jata hai aur sirf \(p\) bachta hai. Kitab yeh beech wali line \(3p = -6\) chhor deti hai.

Step 4: \(q\) nikalein
(i) mein \(p = -2\) rakhein:
\[q = p + 1 = -2 + 1 = -1\]
Kyun: (i) yani \(p - q = -1\) ko \(q\) ke liye hal karein to \(q = p + 1\).

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Yeh hamari practice hai, kitab ka sawal nahin. Kya \(x + 3\), \(x^{3} + 27\) ka factor hai?
Hal: \(a = -3\); \(f(-3) = (-3)^{3} + 27 = -27 + 27 = 0\). Haan, factor hai.
Ab khud: kya \(x - 1\), \(x^{3} + 27\) ka factor hai? (Jawab: \(f(1) = 28 \ne 0\), is liye nahin.)

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Factor theorem: \(x - a\), \(f(x)\) ka factor hai agar aur sirf agar \(f(a) = 0\).
2. "\(x - a\) factor hai", "\(f(a) = 0\)", "\(a\) equation \(f(x) = 0\) ka root hai" aur "remainder 0 hai": chaaron ek hi baat hain.
3. Factor check karna ho to value nikalein; coefficients dhoondne hon to har diye hue factor ke liye \(f(a) = 0\) likh kar equations hal karein.
4. Jitne unknowns, utni equations chahiye: Example 6 mein do unknowns aur do factors.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Factor \(x + 1\) ke liye \(f(1)\) nikal lena; sahi \(f(-1)\) hai.
2. Signs mein ghalti: \(q(-1) = -q\) aur \(p(-1)^{2} = +p\).
3. "\(f(a) = 0\)" likh kar ruk jana aur natija na likhna ke "is liye \(x - a\) factor hai".
4. Do equations ko jama/tafreeq karte waqt sirf ek taraf ka sign badalna; dono taraf barabar amal karein.
